query:
SELECT 
  SUM(GREATEST(0, (p.usedHours - p.totalHours) - COALESCE(p.deductedMinutes, 0))) AS totalOutOfPackageMinutes
FROM packages p
JOIN residents r ON p.residentId = r.id
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka' AND p.isActive = 0;
